name: Eyes Roam
overview: Scripture reveals that while individuals may find moments of safety and rest, their eyes often remain watchful of the ways of others, reflecting a restless vigilance (Job 24:23). God’s sovereign oversight is portrayed as eyes that run to and fro across the earth, symbolizing His attentive and comprehensive knowledge of all things, even in seemingly small beginnings (Zechariah 4:10). This divine watchfulness assures believers of God’s thoughtful plans for peace and a hopeful future, emphasizing His purposeful care and guidance (Jeremiah 29:11).
